operators.name: lrn_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: same as reference input [N, C, H, W]

semantics: Performs local response normalization across channels for each spatial location.
For each channel c at spatial location (h,w), computes sum of squares of input values in channel window [max(0, c - floor((size-1)/2)), min(C-1, c + ceil((size-1)/2))].
The size parameter is the total window size along channel dimension; alpha, beta, k are scalars as in F.local_response_norm.
The operation is applied to each batch and spatial position independently, preserving tensor shape, dtype, and device.

reference_steps.source: x = F.local_response_norm(x, self.norm_size, self.alpha, self.beta, self.k)
semantics: Applies local response normalization as described above.
Input x is a 4D tensor of shape [48,3,512,256] float32.
Normalization window size = 5, alpha=1e-4, beta=0.75, k=2.
Output has same shape, dtype, and device as input.
The output of LRN is returned.
No further computation; value equals step_001 output.
